div.head: Aug. 29: Engagement, Smithfield Crossing of the Opequan
div.p: MICHIGAN--1st, 5th, 6th and 7th Cavalry. NEW YORK--4th, 6th, 9th and 19th Cavalry. PENNSYLVANIA--6th and 17th Cavalry. UNITED STATES--1st and 2d Cavalry; Batteries "K & L," 1st Arty.; "D," 2d Arty. Union loss, 10 killed, 90 wounded. Total, 100.

div.head: Aug. 31: Action, Martinsburg
div.p: OHIO--8th Cavalry. NEW YORK--1st (Lincoln) Cavalry. PENNSYLVANIA--14th and 22d Cavalry. WEST VIRGINIA--1st, 2d and 3d Cavalry. UNITED STATES--Battery "L," 5th Arty.

div.head: Sept. 2: Skirmish, Darkesville
div.p: PENNSYLVANIA--22d Cavalry. Union loss, 50 killed, wounded and missing.

div.head: Sept. 2-3: Action, Bunker Hill
div.p: OHIO--8th Cavalry. NEW YORK--1st (Lincoln) Cavalry. PENNSYLVANIA--14th and 22d Cavalry. WEST VIRGINIA--1st, 2d and 3d Cavalry. UNITED STATES--Battery "L," 5th Arty.

div.head: Sept. 8: Skirmish, Beech Fork, Calhoun County
Sept. 10: Skirmish, Darkesville
div.p: OHIO--8th Cavalry. NEW YORK--1st (Lincoln) Cavalry. PENNSYLVANIA--14th and 22d Cavalry. WEST VIRGINIA--1st, 2d and 3d Cavalry. UNITED STATES--Battery "L," 5th Arty.

div.head: Sept. 13: Skirmish, Bunker Hill
div.p: OHIO--8th Cavalry. NEW YORK--1st (Lincoln) Cavalry. PENNSYLVANIA--14th and 22d Cavalry. WEST VIRGINIA--1st, 2d and 3d Cavalry. UNITED STATES--Battery "L," 5th Arty.

div.head: Sept. 23-Oct. 1: Operations in Kanawha Valley
div.p: NEW YORK--1st Cavalry. WEST VIRGINIA--7th Cavalry.

div.head: Oct. 29: Skirmish, Beverly
div.p: OHIO--8th Cavalry (Detachment). Union loss, 8 killed, 25 wounded, 13 missing. Total, 46.

div.head: Nov. 5-12: Operations in Kanawha Valley against Witcher
div.p: NEW YORK--1st Cavalry. WEST VIRGINIA--7th Cavalry.

div.head: Nov. 6-8: Expedition from New Creek to Moorefield
div.p: ILLINOIS--Battery "L," 1st Light Arty. WEST VIRGINIA--5th Cavalry; 6th Cavalry (Detachments).

div.head: Nov. 18: Skirmish, Kablestown
div.p: OHIO--36th and 91st Infantry. WEST VIRGINIA--13th Infantry.

div.head: Nov. 27-28: Skirmishes, Moorefield
div.p: ILLINOIS--Battery "L," 1st Light Arty (Section). WEST VIRGINIA--6th Cavalry.

div.head: Nov. 28: Affair, New Creek
div.p: ILLINOIS--Battery "L," 1st Light Arty. WEST VIRGINIA--5th and 6th Cavalry; Battery "E," Light Arty.; 6th Infantry.

div.head: Nov. 28-Dec. 2: Expedition from Kernstown to Moorefield
Jan. 11: Capture of Beverly
div.p: OHIO--8th Cavalry; 34th Infantry. Union loss, 6 killed, 23 wounded, 580 captured and missing. Total, 609.

div.head: Jan. 11-15: Scout to Greenland Gap and Franklin
March 16-17: Scout from Summit Point to Kablestown, Myerstown and Shenandoah Ferry
March 22: Skirmish near Patterson's Creek Station
